In the observed runs confidence remained 50 (< GUARDED_MIN_CONFIDENCE 62) with no conflict/spiking/disagreement guarded-risk blockers recorded—indicating net adjustments did not lift confidence above the base (insufficient alignment/ADX contribution for this setup) so the guarded pre-proposal gate correctly refused without creating a proposal/order. This is a threshold/gate outcome from underlying inputs, not an execution-confirmation bug.
